meta.title: Cessna 172P physical wiring harness (devices, harness network, routed and bundled wires)
sources: Cessna D2065-3-13 Section 20 wiring diagrams via data/c172p-wiring.json (wire numbers, AWG, terminals, pages)
Cessna D2065-3-13 Section 16 (electrical systems) and Sections 3, 4, 7, 10, 11, 12, 15 for device locations and routing statements (pages cited per item)
FlightGear c172p model (c172p-team, GPL-2.0): assets/c172p.glb, assets/cockpit.glb, data/cockpit-parts.json
engine-full.js geometry (machine.js: translate (-1.72, -0.068, 0), rotate z -3 deg), dumped by tools/dump_engine_full.html
meta.frame: raw AC3D frame of Models/c172-common.ac: meters, +x aft, +y up, +z toward the LEFT wing

notes.basis: exact-model = a FlightGear model object; manual-located = location stated or drawn in the manual (page cited), coordinates fitted to the model; estimated = no location in the manual or the model.
notes.segment basis: 'manual' segments follow a routing statement or figure (page cited); 'conventional routing, not stated in the manual' marks Cessna-practice paths where the manual is silent.
notes.firewall: Model firewall is x ~ -0.77 at mid height (cockpit Firewall object); the fitted Cessna transform puts FS 0 about 7 cm further forward. Firewall devices are placed on the model's firewall.
notes.breaker strip: The FlightGear strip has 16 breakers in its own order; wires land on the model breaker of the same name. ALT FIELD, AIR COND and STBY VAC have no model object and take free slots (estimated).
notes.wing disconnects: LH housing S-1640-6/S-1641-6 (6 pins) and RH S-1640-9/S-1641-9 (9 pins) as drawn in Section 20; LH landing/taxi lights use a separate 3-pin connector 8/9 at the root.
notes.alternatives: All wires effective for the 172P range are included, so alternatives coexist (1981 cowl vs 1982+ wing landing lights; analog vs digital clock; three oil-temperature variants; both strobe breakers; optional equipment).
notes.bundles: Wires sharing a segment are packed into a round bundle by outer diameter (AWG -> OD: 22=1.25, 20=1.45, 18=1.7, 16=2.0, 14=2.4, 10=3.6, 8=4.6, 4=7.4 mm; 18S shielded 2.6 mm); slots blend over 3.5 cm at nodes.

notes: Wing section refit to the true-scale wing by tools/refit_harness_wing.py (meta.refit of c172p-structure-wing-3d.json): 2488 points moved (max 185 mm); 18 wire ends moved to refit devices; 11 of 2208 wing points outside the new skin's depth. The full re-route against the new ribs and spars (tools/build_harness.py) did not complete; wires cross ribs at their old paths.
